# Agentic Privacy — Solana devnet

> For AI agents: a private connection through a Sentinel dVPN node on Solana devnet. No account, no API key,
> nothing hosted: you hold a key file, you pay the node directly in test tokens (devnet only, no value), you
> connect, and you get the unused deposit back. Two paths: Path A uses the Sentinel dVPN app's command line
> `devnet-dvpn` (Windows, Linux, macOS); Path B uses only Sentinel's own public tools, `sentinel-dvpnd` and
> `sentinel-dvpn` (Linux).

Pick one path and read its first file top to bottom once.

- **Path A (the app):** [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Install v0.3.0-rc8 by name (macOS: v0.3.0-rc4); the first command after install is
  `devnet-dvpn agent status --json`. Every answer carries `next` (the command to run next) or, on failure, `action`.
  Add `--json` for one line of JSON; nothing spends without `--yes` (without it: a preview, exit code 2).
- **Path B (direct, Linux):** [docs/DIRECT.md](docs/DIRECT.md). The first command is
  `git clone https://github.com/Sentinel-Bluebuilder/agentic-privacy-solana-devnet && cd agentic-privacy-solana-devnet && sudo sh direct/install.sh`.
  Already have a funded key file: `sudo KEYFILE=<path> sh direct/install.sh` (see "Already have a funded key file?").
  Writing your own code against the on-chain program: [docs/BUILD-YOUR-OWN-CLIENT.md](docs/BUILD-YOUR-OWN-CLIENT.md).

The one step you cannot do alone on either path: funding. A person uses two web faucets; the page gives the
exact message to send them.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Path A, install to refund, with the commands per OS. Safety rules at the top.
- [docs/DIRECT.md](docs/DIRECT.md): Path B with `sentinel-dvpnd` + `sentinel-dvpn` (Linux).
- [docs/DIRECT-REFERENCE.md](docs/DIRECT-REFERENCE.md): Path B's tables: every exit, `code` and `money` class, each raw command, every error message and its fix. Path B's own codes (rows in [docs/CODES.md](docs/CODES.md), anchors `#code-direct-<code>`): `download-failed`, `install-failed`, `build-failed`, `no-device`, `route-failed`, `session-dropped`, `step-failed`, `interrupted`, `unknown`, `key-unsafe`; it shares the app's names where a twin exists (`not-funded`, `no-nodes`, `usage`, …).
- [docs/BUILD-YOUR-OWN-CLIENT.md](docs/BUILD-YOUR-OWN-CLIENT.md): your own code: build the transactions against the `dvpn` program, then drive `sentinel-dvpnd`.
- [direct/install.sh](direct/install.sh): Path B's installer; then `direct/fund-request.sh`, `direct/connect.sh`, `direct/disconnect.sh`, `direct/refund.sh`.
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): every term and JSON field, one line each, with the command that shows or changes it.
- [docs/AGENT-COMMANDS.md](docs/AGENT-COMMANDS.md): every field and `next` of `agent status`, `agent up`, `agent down`.
- [docs/CODES.md](docs/CODES.md): every failure `code`: meaning, whether money moved, the command to run.
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): symptom → cause → exact command.
- [docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md](docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md): what the keys can sign, the spending limit, what a node sees.
- [docs/agent-safety.md](docs/agent-safety.md): kill switch, DNS, split tunnelling and SSH lock-out, per OS.
- [docs/OPERATOR.md](docs/OPERATOR.md): for the person who funds you: what you do and what it costs.
- [mcp/README.md](mcp/README.md): Path A as MCP tools, for MCP clients.
- [install.sh](install.sh), [install.ps1](install.ps1): Path A's one-command installers (Linux; Windows. macOS: by hand, see INSTALL-BY-HAND).

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed for an agent per release (rc4 → rc5 → rc6 → rc7 → rc8), breaking changes first.
- [docs/PROVENANCE.md](docs/PROVENANCE.md): every file an agent runs, with its SHA-256, release, source commit, build command and when it was last verified.
- [docs/INSTALL-BY-HAND.md](docs/INSTALL-BY-HAND.md): install the app without the installer script: download, check against SHA256SUMS, install, per OS (macOS rc4: only here).
- [docs/CHOICES.md](docs/CHOICES.md): protocol, country, pricing, split tunnelling and the kill switch.
- [docs/OLDER-RELEASES.md](docs/OLDER-RELEASES.md): v0.3.0-rc2, rc4, rc5 and rc6 differences, and the single commands behind `agent up` / `agent down`.
- [docs/JSON-FIELDS.md](docs/JSON-FIELDS.md): `agent status` fields vs `wallet show` fields, with the units.
- [docs/PROOF.md](docs/PROOF.md): what has been proven, per OS and release, and the known gaps.
- [docs/agent-answers.schema.json](docs/agent-answers.schema.json): JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of every `agent` answer and the error shape.
